subject: Post-call: economics + approval path for FastRetail pilot
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@fastretail.co>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap — economics + approval path (FastRetail)

Thanks again for the time today, Alicia — good conversation. Quick recap and concrete next steps so we all have the same picture.

Call highlights (short):
- Volume signal: you indicated ~30M tokens/month steady-state for the recommendation engine plus spikes to 50M during promotions.
- Target unit economics: procurement is looking for an order-of-magnitude cost per 1M tokens to validate against current vendor spend. We discussed a target range in the ballpark of $800–$1,200 / 1M tokens.
- Contract preference: 6–12 month committed term preferred by Tom / Eng, procurement will handle SOW and PO.

Open asks / actions we need from FastRetail:
1) Confirmation of economic buyer and approver chain — Alicia can you confirm whether Tom Baxter (SVP Eng) is the final economic owner and whether finance requires a formal budget approval before procurement executes?
2) Confirm target monthly budget range (high/low) so we can model price tiers.
3) Any onboarding constraints (data residency / SOC2 evidence) that should be on the MSA? Procurement asked about SOC2 status — we can share our SOC2 Type II report and audit contacts.

What Redwood will do next:
- Attach: rough monthly volume worksheet (FastRetail_Monthly_volume_estimate.xlsx) — I filled the call notes into a few scenarios.
- Sales -> SE (Sean): can you run quick unit-econ scenarios and recommended price bands for 30M / 50M commitments?
- I’ll draft a one-page mutual action plan and proposed next-step calendar for a decision call with Tom + Finance.

Proposed timeline: share pricing scenarios by EOD Wednesday (Nov 4), then a decision/approval call on Tue Nov 10 if that works for Tom.

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0142

Attachment: FastRetail_Monthly_volume_estimate.xlsx (xlsx)

Subject: Re: Post-call recap — economics + approval path (FastRetail)

Thanks Vanessa — quick answers below.

1) Economic owner: Yes, Tom Baxter (SVP Engineering) will sign off on the economic side for the pilot. He wants a short summary of monthly spend and ROI before committing.

2) Budget range: We're targeting an initial pilot budget of $20k–$35k/month (we will scale after pilot if the model improves CTR/conv). That maps roughly to the 30M token estimate you captured.

3) Finance / procurement: Procurement will need a line-item quote and our Finance team (procurement loops) will approve. We use DocuSign for the MSA. SOC2 evidence is required — please share the Type II report.

Next steps from our side: I’ll send Tom a short note to pull him into the decision call if you send proposed times. He’d prefer a morning PST slot on Nov 10–11.

Alicia Gomez
Director, ML Product — FastRetail
alicia.gomez@fastretail.co
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>

Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: FastRetail — confirm econ buyer & prepare pricing bands

Folks — Alicia confirmed Tom is the economic owner and procurement wants a line-item quote + SOC2 report. Budget range is ~$20k–$35k/mo (approx 30M tokens). Please prioritize:
- Sean: run unit economics for 30M steady / 50M promo with caching and without. Include 1M-token price equivalents and an estimate of expected latency impact for the promo case.
- Dev: can you produce 2 price-band options: a) committed 6-month reserved with stepped discounts; b) flexible pay-as-you-go with a small commitment credit? I want the numbers broken into $/1M token buckets (e.g., $X / 1M for 0–10M, $Y for 10–50M).
- Marissa: prepare a short commercial one-pager and a minimal MSA + redlines checklist for procurement. Keep DocuSign-ready version.

I'd like these by EOD Wednesday so we can send an internal proposal to Alicia Thurs morning.

Thanks —
Vanessa
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 13:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Internal: FastRetail — confirm econ buyer & prepare pricing bands

Quick modeling attached (pricing-scenarios.csv). High level:
- Baseline PAYG suggestion: $1,100 / 1M tokens for small volume (<10M), volume discounts thereafter.
- 6-month committed (recommended for predictability): tiered pricing
  - 0–10M: $950 / 1M
  - 10–50M: $820 / 1M
  - >50M: $700 / 1M
- For the 30M steady scenario: effective blended price ≈ $860 / 1M → ~ $25,800 / month.
- With caching + prefix reuse (recommended): estimated token engineering savings ~20% (effective $/1M drops to ≈ $690 blended).

Notes and risks:
- Promo spikes to 50M without commit will increase marginal cost unless we add burst capacity or temporary reserved buffer.
- SOC2: we can share Type II report; I'll include contact for attestations.

Attachment: pricing-scenarios.csv

Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal & next steps — 6-month pilot estimate and approval call

Alicia / Tom — following up with a short proposal based on our modeling. Summary below and attachments (one-pager + pricing scenarios).

Summary (recommended):
- Pilot term: 6 months committed (allows discounted tiers, predictable budget).
- Estimated steady usage: 30M tokens / month → blended price ≈ $860 / 1M → est. $25.8k/month.
- With proactive caching and prefix reuse we expect ~20% token savings → effective cost ≈ $20.6k/month.
- Promo capacity: recommend adding a 20M token reserved buffer for campaign spikes at the 10–50M tier price to avoid large marginal cost during promotions.

Ask from FastRetail:
1) Confirm approval chain (Tom to sign MSA and procurement to issue PO) — Alicia, can you confirm who in Finance signs the PO?
2) Approve proposed Nov 10 decision call (morning PST preferred).

Attachments: Redwood_Mutual_Action_Plan.pdf, pricing-scenarios.csv, FastRetail_Monthly_volume_estimate.xlsx
DocuSign preview: https://docusign.example/embedded/ABC123-FT-RDW
HubSpot record: https://hubspot.example/contacts/FT-2091

If that looks good I’ll send a calendar invite and the DocuSign package for the MSA + 6-month SOW.
